title: Lions in Tanzania: Facts and Where to Find Them
excerpt: Lions are the stars of the Serengeti. Facts about their behaviour, prides and where to find them in Tanzania.
body:
## Prides

Lions are the only truly social cats. A pride consists of related females, their cubs and one or more males.

## Hunting

Females do most of the hunting, often together. Males defend the territory.

## Rest

Lions can rest up to 20 hours a day.

## Roaring

A lion's roar can be heard for kilometres.

## Where in Tanzania

- Serengeti, especially Seronera.
- Ngorongoro Crater.
- Ruaha and Nyerere.
- [Tree-climbing lions at Lake Manyara](/blog/tree-climbing-lions-manyara/).

## Threats

Habitat loss and conflict with people. Tanzania has one of the largest lion populations in Africa.
